subject: VeloTech bake-off — evaluation credit proposal and terms
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@velotech.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: VeloTech RFP — request for evaluation credits and guardrails

Alex —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. We're running a three-week bake-off (CloudPrompt vs Redwood) as part of an RFP — looking for a short-term credit allocation and a clear support plan so our engineers can run at scale without environment drift. Key asks:

- 50k–100k tokens of eval credit (we can narrow after you confirm pricing cadence)
- A staging endpoint or tokens scoped to the trial so models and logs remain separate from prod
- One dedicated SE touch (kickoff + one troubleshooting session)

Procurement lead is Nora Chen (nora.chen@velotech.com) and she'll need terms for approval. Can you confirm what you can provide by Friday? Also: are there any benchmarking non-disparagement clauses we should be aware of?

Cheers,
Liam
Director of Product, VeloTech

[Attachment: Velo_RFP_summary.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@velotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VeloTech RFP — request for evaluation credits and guardrails

Hi Liam —

Thanks — this is straightforward to support. Proposed package:

- 60,000 token credit applied to a sandbox project (isolated billing and logs)
- 2-week trial extension option (if benchmark run needs more cycles)
- Dedicated SE kickoff (1 hour) and one 60-minute troubleshooting session during the bake-off
- Standard competitive-benchmark clause in our terms (no public disparaging claims; internal benchmarking ok)

Attaching our standard eval credit template and a short note on quota scoping so your engineers can wire the test harness. If that looks good, Marissa can approve the promotional credit and Ben will handle the quota config.

Next steps: please confirm success criteria (latency P95, quality prompts, and throughput target) and Nora's PO timeline so we can reserve capacity.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_eval_credit_template.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@velotech.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VeloTech RFP — promotional credit approval

Alex / Ben —

Approve 60k tokens for this bake-off with the following conditions:

- Credit is valid for the isolated sandbox project only; no cross-account consumption.
- Allow one 2-week extension upon request (documented success criteria must be shared).
- Marketing/public disclosures require mutual review; internal benchmark results are fine for Buzz/PR only after both parties agree.
- Deal id: DEAL-2028-VEL-0042 — include this on the approval letter for procurement.

Ben, please prepare the terms packet and quota config; cc Nora for procurement so she has what she needs to sign off.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@velotech.com>, Nora Chen <nora.chen@velotech.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: VeloTech — credit terms and quota config

Hi Liam / Nora —

Attached are: 1) Velo_credit_terms_v1.pdf (formal promo terms), and 2) proposal_quota.xlsx showing token quotas and per-minute rate limits for the sandbox project. Highlights:

- 60,000 token promotional credit, applies only to sandbox project ID VEL-EVAL-2028
- Quota: 10 requests / minute baseline, burst to 30 rpm for 10 minutes (configurable)
- Logging: audit logs exported to your S3 bucket (read-only access) for the bake-off window
- Support: 1 kickoff + 1 troubleshooting session (remote). Onsite support can be scoped separately.

[Attachment: Velo_credit_terms_v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: proposal_quota.xlsx (XLSX)]

If procurement is good with the terms, Nora — once you send the PO we can issue the credit and spin up the sandbox project. Happy to hop on a call to walk through the quota sheet.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Nora Chen <nora.chen@velotech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VeloTech — credit terms and quota config

Ben / Alex —

Procurement reviewed Velo_credit_terms_v1.pdf and the quota sheet. We're good to proceed pending a PO. A couple of clarifications from legal (minor edits):

- Add a 30-day data retention window for sandbox logs (to satisfy our internal policies).
- Confirm that the promotional credit will not auto-convert to paid charges after expiration (we require explicit purchase to continue).

If you can incorporate these two items into the final terms, I will generate the PO and route it for signature today. Thanks — Nora

Nora Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager, VeloTech
procurement@velotech.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Chen <nora.chen@velotech.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@velotech.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VeloTech — credit terms and quota config

Nora —

Thanks, we'll update the terms to: 1) enforce a 30-day retention window for sandbox logs, and 2) explicitly state credits will not auto-convert to paid billing. Ben will push the revised PDF within the hour.

Once you send the PO we will:
- Create sandbox project VEL-EVAL-2028
- Apply 60,000 token credit
- Schedule the SE kickoff (propose Mon 3/27 or Tue 3/28)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll keep the team looped and share a short kickoff agenda.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: support_plan-velotech.pdf (PDF)]
